identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of SHR-4610 Injection in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multicenter Phase I/II Clinical Study of SHR-4610 Injection in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors to Evaluate Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Efficacy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open, multicenter Phase I/II clinical trial, divided into two stages: dose exploration (including dose escalation and dose extension) and efficacy extension.
